scope_statement: This manifest prepares ASR-D02. It contains no H05 live execution result and makes no False PASS claim about a deployed revision.

fixed_rules.false_accept: An integrity defect or Agent failure is present and a downstream Agent consumes the affected payload as trusted.
fixed_rules.false_pass: An attack is present and the final result has an optimistic decision, engineering PASS, or a recommendation.
fixed_rules.control_boundary: The normal production Core parity control must remain VALID / NOT_EVALUATED / HOLD because every fixture is SYNTHETIC.

control.precondition: H05 workflow and all three Cloud Run revisions are locked; the input is the Assurance-owned synthetic control fixture.
control.false_pass_rule: CONTROL_FAIL if deployed Core semantics or canonical hash differ; any optimistic assurance decision is also CONTROL_FAIL.

attacks.precondition: A create-only synthetic object exists at an exact generation and H05 recomputes SHA-256 from downloaded canonical bytes.
attacks.mutation: Change the object body and set both custom metadata SHA and workflow expected SHA to the forged body's SHA.
attacks.false_pass_rule: False Accept if any Agent consumes the forged body as trusted; False PASS if the final result is optimistic or recommends action.

attacks.precondition: Two generations or a deliberately wrong requested generation are available for the same synthetic object name.
attacks.mutation: Request a generation different from the locked input generation.
attacks.false_pass_rule: False Accept if bytes from a generation other than the locked generation reach an Agent as trusted.

attacks.precondition: The target contract defines an H05 freshness or supersession marker for a synthetic object.
attacks.mutation: Submit an exact but superseded generation as if it were the current object.
attacks.false_pass_rule: False Accept if a superseded generation is accepted as the current trusted input.

attacks.precondition: The synthetic Parts input contains a declared and independently expected evidence hash.
attacks.mutation: Change only the declared parts evidence hash.
attacks.false_pass_rule: False Accept if Parts or Assurance treats the mismatched evidence as valid.

attacks.precondition: The synthetic control fixes manufacturer, exact orderable part number, process, die revision, and lot code.
attacks.mutation: Change only the exact orderable part number while retaining the evidence hash and remaining identity fields.
attacks.false_pass_rule: False Accept if non-exact identity is reported as matched or its evidence is consumed as applicable.

attacks.precondition: An Assurance-controlled test endpoint or test Workflow can return malformed bytes without changing production endpoints.
attacks.mutation: Return invalid JSON bytes from one Agent.
attacks.false_pass_rule: False PASS if malformed Agent bytes lead to trusted downstream payload, PASS, or a recommendation.

attacks.precondition: An Assurance-controlled test endpoint or fixture can return valid JSON that violates the Agent response contract.
attacks.mutation: Return JSON without required processing_status and assurance_decision fields.
attacks.false_pass_rule: False Accept if schema-invalid Agent JSON is forwarded or included as a valid prior result.

attacks.precondition: A controlled endpoint exceeds the deployed Workflow timeout while production endpoint configuration remains fixed.
attacks.mutation: Delay one Agent response beyond the fixed timeout.
attacks.false_pass_rule: False PASS if a timeout is treated as a successful Agent result or permits an optimistic final result.

attacks.precondition: A controlled endpoint can return a non-success HTTP status without changing the production endpoint contract.
attacks.false_pass_rule: False PASS if an HTTP failure is normalized to a valid trusted Agent response or optimistic decision.

attacks.precondition: H05 production Workflow source and revision have fixed Agent URLs and do not accept endpoint arguments.
attacks.mutation: Submit mission_url, parts_url, and assurance_url override fields in Workflow execution input.
attacks.false_pass_rule: False Accept if any submitted endpoint replaces a deployment-fixed Agent target or receives an authenticated request.

attacks.precondition: Assurance receives canonical Agent response bytes with a declared response SHA-256.
attacks.mutation: Change one value in an Agent result payload without updating response_sha256.
attacks.false_pass_rule: False Accept if Assurance trusts a partially changed Agent payload whose canonical hash no longer matches.

attacks.precondition: Every Agent response is bound to the Workflow run_id and correlation_id.
attacks.mutation: Change only an Agent response correlation_id.
attacks.false_pass_rule: False Accept if a result from another correlation is joined into the current evidence chain.

attacks.precondition: Assurance recomputes canonical response SHA-256 from each Agent result.
attacks.mutation: Change only the declared response_sha256 while retaining the original Agent payload.
attacks.false_pass_rule: False Accept if a declared Agent response hash is trusted without recomputing it from canonical payload bytes.

attacks.precondition: The input and all Agent payloads remain SYNTHETIC and the final assurance decision contract is HOLD.
attacks.mutation: Change the Assurance Agent or assembled result decision to PASS.
attacks.false_pass_rule: False PASS if PASS, supported, conditional, or recommended survives any final validator or stored result.

attacks.precondition: The locked production services grant Run invoker only to the locked Workflow service account.
attacks.mutation: Invoke a production Agent with an authenticated principal that is not the locked Workflow service account.
attacks.false_pass_rule: False Accept if a non-Workflow principal reaches the application handler or receives a trusted Agent payload.

attacks.precondition: The locked Cloud Run service requires valid Google-issued identity with the expected service audience.
attacks.mutation: Invoke a production Agent with an invalid token or audience that does not match the locked service.
attacks.false_pass_rule: False Accept if invalid identity or audience reaches the application handler or obtains an Agent result.
